prerequisites.rationale_text: Counterfactual reasoning requires deliberate mental simulation of alternative states — constructing decision trees, scenario analysis, and WTWHTB tests are all effortful System 2 operations that cannot run on autopilot.
prerequisites.source_quote: Counterfactual Reasoning is the exploration of alternative possibilities — imagining states of the world or outcomes that did not happen but could have happened.

curation_notes.summary: Implicit but strong. The article describes processes (scenario trees, WTWHTB analysis, deliberate hypothesis construction) that are definitionally System 2. Not explicitly named but the dependency is structural.
